$description: Design tokens of Contextura, in the format of the W3C Design Tokens Community Group. contextura.css carries the same values as CSS variables.

home.$description: The home brain: personal and family knowledge.

work.$description: The work brain: what a person knows at work.

company.$description: The company brain: shared context of an organization.

platform-ink.$description: Text in the platform colour on paper.

alert.$description: Errors, what never leaves, a red lamp.

muted.$description: Connections, inactive parts, a lamp that is off.

ok.$description: A green lamp; same value as company.

warn.$description: An orange lamp; a shade darker than home, so it reads as a status.

surface.$description: Cards, the inside of a station.

ink.$description: Text, the person, transfers, the terminus.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text, notes under a station name.

mono.$description: Numbers, statuses, small labels in capitals.

line.$description: A main line on a map.

branch.$description: A feeder line, the ring of a station, the end of a line.

stop.$description: The ring of a small stop, the person.

transfer.$description: The two strokes of a transfer.
